summary: REJECT, but NO live functional bug -- purely a rule/test-consistency issue. All 8 flagged sites are confirmed functionally safe today (correctly same-call with their governing rebuild). Fix (reviewer's own 'truthful-rule route', smaller diff, preferred given this file is already 700+ lines across 7 bloat-exception rounds): reword campaign-mode.md:262-273 to the rule actually implemented -- 'exactly one run_dir= rebuild must OPEN every contiguous shell block that touches a $run_dir/ path, where a block ends at any model judgement or Agent-tool spawn' -- drop the 'no exception from same-call reasoning' and 'only form a test can enforce' clauses; tighten test lookbacks['3g'] from None to a real window (500 works -- 3g's farthest use sits ~450 normalized chars from its rebuild). Also update the ADR's round-7 entry (bloat-exception.md:428-437) to match what actually shipped rather than describing an unconditional 5-site-only rule. Confirmed clean: all previously-settled rounds' fixes intact (pin-diff equality, fires fail-closed guard, unit-scoped gh pr view x3, git -C on both add/commit/push paths, bounded-wait re-checks, --payload-file at $unit_wt, single-backslash continuations, --mode ship ordering, no-unpinned-merge acceptance criterion).
